context.body: Divine action and Noah’s patient testing alternate before the ground is fully dry.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: God remembers Noah and the animals, sends a wind, and restrains the waters; Noah later opens the window and sends a raven and a dove.
observations.label: God remembers Noah as the waters recede: action

observations.body: Noah waits through repeated intervals, reads the olive leaf, removes the covering, and sees dry ground.
observations.label: God remembers Noah as the waters recede: response

observations.body: remembered Noah · wind · raven · dove · waited · knew
observations.label: Words in Genesis 8:1–14

payload.posture: Read Genesis 8:1–14 as remembered and restored evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage says God remembered Noah together with the animals, while leaving the experience of the long waiting largely undescribed.
payload.title: God remembers Noah as the waters recede
